provenance.basis: reviewed post-merge E1/G1/T1 saved scenario ensembles, not blind teacher inputs
provenance.authorship: development-author-selected, retrospectively constructed from already observed E1/G1/T1 evidence

questions.question: At the saved probe (1.5, -0.4, 1.4) m, which independent electric source replacement decreases the field magnitude relative to the common fresh baseline, and which increases it? Give the exact signed differences in N/C, not absolute field magnitudes.
questions.notes: Both alternatives replace an original negative line with distinct illustrative positive-line sources. These are not sequential line moves or actual charging dynamics.

questions.question: In gravity hypothesis-B, can the saved position of the newly added body_4 be differenced against the fresh baseline at the requested time? State the actual original comparison outcome without inventing a baseline body or zero displacement.
questions.notes: Hypothesis-B adds body_4 and alters source_A mass. Its native run can be complete while the cross-scenario body_4 position comparison is unavailable; the missing left operand is not a numeric zero.

questions.question: At the same ordered from_m to to_m probe locations, report the saved signed change in the potential difference for each independent static shell-plus-point charge hypothesis, in volts. Do not attribute either whole difference to only the shell.
questions.notes: Each accepted hypothesis changes both original prescribed shell and central-point charges. The domain is static electric potential, not a conducting-shell polarization response.
